title: Climax and Such
overview: “Welcome to the planetarium! I’m Yumemi Hoshino, and I’ll be your guide.” An abandoned planetarium in the middle of nowhere. A lovely guest pays a visit, and timeless memories illuminate the night sky. The story of a small miracle begins.

title: The Title, Etc.
overview: Ryou Fujibayashi gathers with some of the other girls to discuss their personalities. There must be a way to improve her standing among the cast! Also, the mystery of the title of this anime is solved.

title: Club Activities, Etc.
overview: “That was a sight to behold...” Club activity is the centerpiece of school life. Liberal-arts-oriented clubs are great too, but sports-oriented clubs are the most exciting. Youths battling for their pride and ideal. Ah, the springtime of life.

title: Swimwear, Etc.
overview: It's swimming time! Naturally, the boys can't stop trying to take a peek at what their female classmates look like in swimsuits. However, something unnatural is going on with the sizes of the girls' bodies... Literally.

title: Holiday, Etc.
overview: Even in this world, Yukito is broke. Fortunately, he found a place where he can legally show off his talents to make money. Unfortunately, nobody seems to be interested. Yukito decides it's time to take matters into his own hands.

title: Little Sisters, Etc.
overview: Elder siblings gather to discuss an obvious truth: there is nothing wrong with being absolutely obsessed with their respective little sisters. But the discussion naturally transitions to whose little sister is cutest, resulting in rising tensions...

title: Charades, Etc.
overview: Elder siblings gather to prove an obvious truth: their love for their respective little sisters is the strongest. Naturally, the best way to do this is through baseball.

title: Soulmates, Etc.
overview: What are soulmates? Two people bound by fate? Love? Blood relations? Or... similar voices?

title: Protagonists, Etc.
overview: The protagonists of the five Key franchises gather to discuss the hardships they face. It isn't easy being a hero surrounded by beautiful girls! No, really, you don't understand.

title: Carnival Preparations, Etc.
overview: The school is preparing for a festival! However...

title: Day of the Carnival, Etc.
overview: The Kaginado Academy Carnival begins! The space-time continuum is completely ignored to allow several miraculous encounters.

title: The School Carnival Ends, and Then… Etc.
overview: The Kaginado Academy Carnival Arc enters its third and final episode! The long-awaited beauty contest begins, bringing the event to a powerful climax. But it's not the climax anyone expected.
